youtube.title: Do architects really fear floor 13? 🏨 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description: Thirteen floors up, there is a floor that officially does not exist, and thousands of buildings have one. Maybe the one you slept in last night. Why would the most modern buildings on Earth pretend a floor is not there? Not because architects believe in bad luck, but because guests do. Hotels say some guests ask to change rooms when given one on thirteen, and no developer wants to spend millions on a floor people fear. Full episode on the channel. #Shorts #hotels #architecture #facts #thehiddenwhy
